facts.text: Frank's on the grill tonight and the beers are cold. Pull up a chair before I eat all the snags.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Frank's words, but it is not a line from the film. 'Snags' is Australian slang for sausages and does not belong in a US film. I could not open a quote page for this pass (the search tool was out of budget), so there is no quote source.
facts.fix: Frank on the grill tonight and the beers are cold. Pull up a chair before the Tank eats everything.

vibe.verdict: A fair frat party, but the black and white photo strip is flat and the film's best set pieces and cameos are barely touched.
missing: Blue's death at his birthday and his 'You're my boy, Blue' line
Frank in the school mascot suit jumping through the ring of fire
Frank beating James Carville in the debate
The rhythmic gymnastics and the vault at the final evaluation
Bernard, known as Beanie, as the host
ideas: Swap 'Frat house sheet cake' for 'Blue's birthday cake' with a note about his big night.
Swap 'Pledge week jalapeño poppers' for 'Ring of fire poppers' with a note about the mascot jump.
Swap the black and white photo booth for colour pictures with the party in full swing.
Swap 'Mitch's house bourbon lemonade punch' for 'Mitch-a-Palooza punch' to name the party.
